notes.title: Work in progress 2.0.0 update now live on the beta branch
notes.notes:
A work in progress version of the 2.0.0 update is now live on the beta branch for players that are interested in seeing the new stuff early or want to help test balance/technical issues.

To unlock the beta branch, right click on the game in your steam library, open the 'Betas' tab, enter 'tolagalbetabranch' in to the password text box and click the 'Check code' button. You should now be able to select the beta branch in the  drop down list. When you select the beta branch steam should download an update for the game.

The current patch notes are available to view here: https://trello.com/c/iCsGN9Sk/561-2-0-0

If you do decide to test it would be great if you could post feedback in the discussion forum :)

Cheers!

notes.title: v1.1.1 update now live
notes.notes:
This update fixes the following bugs:

[list]
[*] Monsters no longer spawn inside vases in the deep moot.
[*] Bleed damage can no longer be less than 1.
[*] Healing rings will no longer lose their charge when moving between levels while inside your backpack
[*] OSX 10.10 launch problems should be solved
[/list]

Cheers!

notes.title: v1.1.0 update - adds basic achievements
notes.notes:
Not such a huge update - it just adds some achievements which are all based on how far you have progressed in normal mode. In the future I'm planning to add more hidden achievements as well as some for infinite mode.

Most of the work was behind the scenes stuff to integrate the game with the Steam API, but I also fixed a bug!

- The Ashdurbuk's health bar will no longer cover his face!

Cheers!
